data.name: Farukh
data.gender_notes: Farukh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Persian, Farukh means 'horse'. In Hindu mythology, the horse represents power, strength, and victory. The name Farukh is believed to bring joy and success in life. The name Farukh carries the meaning “Horse or Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Farukh usually hope their child will grow to embody horse or joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and power.
data.etymology: Farukh belongs to the Persian linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Horse or Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farukh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
